entry_points.text: Filter takes context plus data; visitor takes visit context; each returns disposition.
Entry restores tag checks on hardware plus request; fault validation runs for async tags.
Lazy entry idles with conditional barrier; install syncs caches and tags once per batch.
Access install merges perms atomically with local invalidate; swap tags erase when supported.
Single install unfolds then refolds; thread start zeroes regs and installs PC and status.
Early guard creates randomised per-task canary and enables pointer authentication.

exports.text: Linear and image ranges use base adjustment; helpers map both ways plus frames and validity.
User size rewrite skipped when set; idmap install and remove bracket replacement with flush.
Middle and upper levels clear by zero store and expose phys, virt and table views.
Modify-prot owned by arch; get-and-clear unfolds; try-set installs into empty with barriers.
Percpu offsets use thread register; preempt shorthands alias patchable or direct calls.
Memory ranges advance to frontier; version queries monitor; attestation validates length.
Logical CPUs map via MPIDR table; hypervisor unwind starts from caller frame and PC.

hazards.text: Control overflow traps; shared hypervisor walk fails; locked, donated and poison values invalid.
TCR read unordered; replacement must mask faults; PLT near page end forbidden on some CPUs.
Live valid-to-valid attr changes warn; swapper members need dedicated installer plus barrier.
Folded descent reuses top pointer; legacy contig overwrite warns; partials risk faults.
Preempt counts race IRQs except decrement; patch targets need word alignment and maintenance.
Debug transfer shares encoding by direction; priority aliases equal; endian and range vary by build.
Single-CPU wakeup unavailable; physical cover and sparse section sizes bound configurations.

invariants.text: Nested level packs in combined field; range decode treats zero granule as largest and caps span.
Size codes map to widths; max range follows LPA2 support and CPU value is clamped.
Validity uses low bit; conversions mask and relocate high bits; block needs level and mask.
Leaf tests cover empty, young, dirty, contig and bad; privileged invalid marks protnone.
Contiguous folding is user-only, needs one folio with uniform prot, preserving OR of flags.
Keys need overlay hardware; allocation scans bitmask lowest free with validation on release.
Vector lengths tracked per kind with next-exec; TTBR0 addresses stay below task size.
Call number in dedicated field; minus one suppresses dispatch; wrappers delouse compat args.
SCTLR init builds RES1 plus MMU, caches and endian; sysreg and TLBI encodings use fixed fields.
SGI shares one ID per kind; LPI per-CPU with forced affinity; boot status uses store plus barrier.

locks.text: Hypervisor rejects shared walks; kernel takes protection only for shared walks with symmetric release.
Tag publication orders after writes; atomic test-and-set elects initializer, others wait then skip.
Locked read folds flags under lock; lockless retries on invalid or inconsistent snapshot.
Patch stores hold lock with IRQs saved; tag area erase holds store lock across interval.

state_machines.text: S1 result is translated with perms or failed with fault code; helper performs transition.
Kernel base replacement installs idmap, masks events, replaces, unmasks, then uninstalls.
Convert aligns, merges flags, optionally flushes, repaints; unfold and access expand partials.
Upper installs depend on enablement; disabled builds skip or fail; folded queries report flags.
Preempt word packs counter with inverted reschedule flag; decrement rereads to tolerate races.
Parked secondary waits low-power; Spectre state is exclusive; hyp vectors select bounce mode.

structs.text: Levels span negative to max; entries are 64-bit with valid bit, type bit and address masks.
Leaf attrs carry S1/S2 perms and execute controls; walk flags cover shared and skip modes.
Walk pairs info with filter and data; ops supply alloc, free, translate and maintenance.
VA width fixes linear, image and map bases; thread size derives from page order.
Raw values share 64-bit carrier; swap packs type and offset; page bits fix perms and address.
CPU context holds callee-saved plus SP/PC; thread adds TLS, vectors, fault, auth and tags.
Sysreg fields fix shifts and masks; unwind uses bounds plus FP/PC cursor with frame tags.
